title: Command: purge right-now summaries across board
description:
Implement a Kanbus command to purge right-now summary fields across the entire board.

Purge scope (only these fields):
- `right_now_summary`
- `right_now_updated_at`

Must include `virtual_projects` targets, not just the primary project tree.

SD acceptance on `/workspace/projects-meta`.
